    Create a CSS container query wrapper

    container.Rd

    Wraps child elements in a container with CSS Container Query support. Allows responsive styles based on the container's own dimensions rather than the viewport.

    container(
  name,
  ...,
  conditions = list(),
  type = "inline-size",
  class = NULL,
  .style = NULL
)

    Arguments

    name

    Container name. Used as the CSS container-name and as a class on the wrapper element for CSS targeting.

    ...

    Child UI elements.

    conditions

    List of condition objects defining the CSS rules and container queries.

    type

    Container type: "inline-size" (default), "size", or "normal".

    class

    Additional CSS classes for the container div.

    .style

    Additional inline CSS styles (as a string or css output).

    Value

    A tag object.

    Examples

    container(
  name = "demo",
  grid_item(shiny::div(class = "a", "A"), area = "a"),
  grid_item(shiny::div(class = "b", "B"), area = "b"),
  conditions = list(
    condition(!!!grid(template_areas = list(c("a", "b")))),
    condition(
      query = "width < 600px",
      !!!grid(template_areas = list(c("a"), c("b")))
    )
  )
)
#> <div class="demo" style="container-type:inline-size;container-name:demo;">
#>   <div class="sg-container-content" for="demo">
#>     <div class="a" style="grid-area:a;">A</div>
#>     <div class="b" style="grid-area:b;">B</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
